Existence only (no k.keyword predicate). Use movie_keyword__movie_id offsets; first hit short-circuits.
Use movie_companies__movie_id offsets. Per fact row check country_code dict code == us_code. company_type filter trivially satisfied (FK valid).

join_order.build: movie_info (filter info_type_id==it1_id AND note LIKE %internet% AND info LIKE 'USA:% 199%' OR 'USA:% 200%')
join_order.notes: Use movie_info__movie_id offsets. Order checks: cheap int eq (info_type_id) first, then memcmp 'USA:' prefix on info, then memmem ' 199'/' 200' on info, then memmem 'internet' on note. Short-circuit on first match per movie.

filters.predicate: info_type_id == it1_id AND note LIKE '%internet%' AND (info LIKE 'USA:% 199%' OR 'USA:% 200%')

data_structures.cn_country_code: preloaded int16/int32 column array (random access by company_id)
data_structures.aggregation: two scalars: min_kt_kind (string_view), min_title (string_view) with thread-local + final reduce

parallelism.notes: Each worker holds thread-local (min_kt_kind, min_title); merge at end.

per_title_evaluation_order: 1. Driver filter: kt_ids.contains(kind_id) AND production_year > 1990 (cheap; reject early).
2. cc existence with status_id == cct1_id (smallest fact table; most selective companion).
3. mi filter (most selective overall; resolve first among remaining facts).
5. mk existence (free; cheapest last to allow earlier rejections).
execution_notes.min_aggregation: Per surviving title: candidate (kt_kind_by_id[kind_id], title). Update thread-local mins lex-min.
